project_name: Trusted Hardware TPM & Signed Firmware Update Platform
domain: Trusted Computing & Firmware Security (TPM / Secure Boot / OTA)
functionality: Physical TPM tamper protection, power-on self-tests, and digitally signed firmware updates
document_text: The embedded security module shall physically resist manipulation and probing of TPM silicon and run cryptographic self-tests at initialization. Authorized administrators shall query current firmware versions and initiate updates, while the TSF must verify every firmware package with an ECDSA-P256 or RSA-3072 digital signature prior to installation and reject unsigned images.
gold_requirements: Resist physical manipulation and probing of TPM hardware and execute power-on self-tests.
Query current firmware version and restrict firmware update initiation to authorized administrators.
Verify firmware updates via cryptographic digital signature prior to installation.
seeded_conflict_sample: Firmware packages shall be verified using 2048-bit signatures.
Firmware packages shall be verified using 3072-bit signatures.
